cases.prompt: I want a reusable prompt that writes a weekly update. It might be for my clients or might be for my own team, I haven't decided. Help me build it.
assertions: [O] asks about the audience (clients vs team) or states an audience assumption
[O] does not ask in the same round any question whose answer depends on the still-open audience choice (e.g. client-specific tone or team-specific metrics)
[O] each question offers options with a recommended one, worded so a plain yes accepts the recommendation
[O] includes an option to add more context
[O] delivers a first-draft prompt in the same reply

cases.prompt: Write a reusable prompt that turns my discovery-call notes into a one-page summary for HVAC company owners. They read on their phones, want plain English, and I always end with one recommended next step. Notes are usually 1-2 pages of bullets.
assertions: [O] does not ask who the audience is, what reading level to use, how long the notes are, or how the summary should end (all given)
[O] the prompt includes the given facts: HVAC owners, phone reading, plain English, one recommended next step
[O] delivers the prompt as a copyable block
[O] includes a TEST RESULTS or UNTESTED line
